proposals.evidence: DEDR 2453 gives Tamil cāmpal/cāmpar and Malayalam cāmpal ‘ashes’. The proposal is confined to matching camp-/samp- responses; būdi forms have an explicit borrowing warning in DEDR 4316 and are not assigned as inherited here. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
